scope: Independent review of chief baseline design and toy oracle; no production implementation or scenario performance.
acceptance_checks: Receipt identity/digest/base/role/branch and changed-path boundary match the task.
Required outputs and canonical source hashes match parameters.
Independent scalar or rational arithmetic recomputes all chief numeric expectations without importing/executing the chief oracle or production accounting/metrics.

Independently verify 10800/1800/15/1200 output counts and identify any parameter or schema gap.

instructions:
Review specs/DEVELOPMENT_BASELINES.md and specs/development_baselines_v1.json, authored by chief, against PROBLEM_LOCK.md and ACCOUNTING.md. Review audit/chief/accounting_oracle.json and the derivation in accounting_reference.py, then independently recompute every numeric expectation using your own Fraction/Decimal/scalar arithmetic in audit/SOL-002/verify.py. Do not import or execute the chief oracle or production accounting/metrics for expected values.

Check all three policies (bills keep, annual equal weights, initial equal weights then keep), information timing, pro-rata fee funding, target and keep semantics, net annual real returns, H=1 undefined volatility, ddof=1, initial/post-fee drawdowns, linear quantiles, separate scenarios, the five profile horizons, both trade-share denominators, severe-case maximum and tie-break, paired-difference signs, output counts and plan/config consistency. Identify any missing mathematical parameter, necessary output column, unsupported recommendation or ambiguous rule. Provide exact proposed corrections; do not edit chief files.

The pinned base intentionally contains the chief design/oracle, not the eventual accepted SOL-001 implementation. The dependency reserves a review slot after chief accepts SOL-001; review entirely from this pinned base and toy arithmetic. Do not fetch/import later production code.

Deliver review.md with verdict, evidence and limitations; findings.json with schema_version, reviewed_base_commit, source Git-blob hashes, status passed/failed, blockers and corrections; verify.py; and verification.json recording check names, expected/observed numbers and largest residual. The initial verifier run may create verification.json; --check must independently recompute, compare the chief oracle at absolute tolerance 1e-9, check plan invariants and verify the saved evidence without silently regenerating it. A material defect must produce failed findings and nonzero validation exit after diagnosis is saved; preserve all negative findings. Separate minor suggestions from blockers.

Only edit audit/SOL-002; the runner manages handoff. No package installs, scenario performance, policy invention or final-data access. This is an independent review of chief work, not approval of your own prior code or a pilot-driver task.
